nom: Erborian Centella Cleansing Oil with Centella Asiatica

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone skin report the oil rinses off cleanly with no oiliness or residue left behind.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin say it removes makeup without stripping or drying, and some note dry patches improved.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination/mixed (oily plus dry patches) skin found it did not leave the skin oily and left it soft.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including eczema and rosacea, mostly report it is gentle and non-irritating, though two reviewers say it caused eczema and irritation.
segments.mature: One reviewer describes it as transformative for menopausal, fifty-something skin, leaving it smoother and plumper.

concerns.aging: A menopausal reviewer reports smoother, plumper, healthier-feeling skin after a few weeks of use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say skin feels soft, moisturised or hydrated afterward, and some note dry patches or tightness resolved; one reviewer found it left an oily residue rather than hydration.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with eczema and rosacea reports less overall redness and softer, hydrated skin.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with eczema report the oil is soothing and does not strip or worsen dryness, though two other reviewers say the product triggered eczema.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports blackheads reduced and visibly shrunken pores in the T-zone with regular use.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer had a few extra blemishes during the first couple of weeks before skin improved; others report no new breakouts or reactions, and one reports breakouts and reactivity mostly resolved.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers, including oily and combination skin, say the oil rinses away completely with no oily residue or greasy feel.

extraits.texte: Was very excited for this but sadly it irritated my skin and caused eczema. The smell is slightly weird and I wasn't sure if I liked that
It's good at cleansing, but it left an oily residue on my skin when I washed it off. I think this would probably be best for a dry skin type. I have combination skin for reference.
I love this product so far. This oil gives you very nourishing feeling and rinse off very easily. It keeps my face clean. Doesn't irritate my skin at all. I have oily, acne prone skin.

After using the E45 cleansing foam for a while now due to very sensitive skin, I decided to switch to this cleansing oil as I am such a huge fan of other Erborian products. This oil removes make up very effectively and leaves skin feeling so moisturised - I only have to follow up with a little of the Centella Moisturiser afterwards. Can't believe how soft my face feels. I've definitely been converted! If you have sensitive skin, do what I did and order the small size first and see how you get on. I'm back on here today to buy the big bottle!

My poor fifty-something menopausal skin was quite a riot tbh! One of my Insta faves @wearsmymoney -Kate H-recommended this and what a transformation! In only a few weeks my skin feels smoother and plumper and just healthier. I have now switched to all Erborian products for my skincare routine. Cannot recommend this enough! Use with Centella Cleansing Gel for even better results!

I have suffered for a long time with eczema and rosacea. I always felt a bit left out only using prescription products. This was a wonderful buy and has transformed my skin. Less overall redness and it feels soft and hydrated after use. Paired with the centella cream I am never looking back!

extraits.titre: My all time favorite night oil cleanser
extraits.texte: Ive been using this consistently at night. If i skip its bc i didn't go to the gym. But ovverall this has helped my blackheads tremendously!! They were not kiddng that oil pulls oil lol idk i thought that was a myth.. this has proved me wrong. my pores in my t zone/nose has shrunk. Love it
